description: Eight-episode engineering backtest of model-version-17 recurrent GNN-PPO with 3,000 individual State College evacuees. Hazard casualty probability is calibrated to a 40 percent mean cumulative probability after 60 minutes of uninterrupted Level-5 exposure (variance 9 percentage-points squared); lower severity and shorter exposure reduce realized population casualty incidence. This is not a convergence or efficacy study.
